title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy worker-src allows every origin
description: The policy allowed a worker script from any origin. A worker is script execution with the page origin, no DOM, and a lifetime that can exceed the page, which makes it a durable foothold for data collection. The finding is the unbounded worker origin list.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: Foreign script execution inside the page origin; MEDIUM severity.
